extension.description: To help Minecraft developers create resource packs more efficiently
config.title: Minecraft Resourcepack Helper
config.desc.defaultMcAssetsPath: absolute path to vanilla Minecraft assets, used for definitions, completions, and diagnostics; accepts an assets folder, assets/minecraft folder, resource pack root, or vanilla client.jar
config.desc.resourcePackLoadOrder: absolute paths to enabled resource pack directories or ZIPs below the currently edited pack, ordered from higher priority to lower priority
config.desc.tipColorForUndefinedTextureV: the tip color for undefined texture variants in model files
config.desc.rsglEnabled: controls when the integrated RSGL runtime is loaded for this resource-pack project
config.enum.rsglEnabled.auto: load only for an RSGL document, command, known project, or expanded RSGL graph node
config.enum.rsglEnabled.on: preload the RSGL host after a resource-pack project is discovered; the language server remains demand-driven
config.enum.rsglEnabled.off: keep RSGL runtime code, processes, providers, and source watchers disabled
config.desc.rsglFormatStyle: controls the overall whitespace and line-breaking style used when formatting RSGL documents
config.enum.rsglFormatStyle.canonical: use the balanced, deterministic RSGL formatting style recommended for most projects
config.enum.rsglFormatStyle.compact: remove blank lines and tighten spacing inside short inline braces
config.enum.rsglFormatStyle.expanded: expand delimited values and empty statement bodies so nested structures are easier to scan
config.desc.rsglFormatLineWidth: preferred maximum line width used by the RSGL formatter when deciding where to wrap constructs
config.desc.rsglFormatBraceStyle: controls whether opening braces stay on the declaration line or move to the next line
config.enum.rsglFormatBraceStyle.sameLin: keep an opening brace on the same line as its declaration
config.enum.rsglFormatBraceStyle.nextLin: place an opening brace on the line after its declaration
